Task / Business Action: Generate E-Way Bill Part A & Part B for transport consignments > ₹50,000
Business Outcome: Statutory compliance for moving goods across state or intra-state above ₹50,000 threshold
Downstream Impact: Generates 12-digit E-Way Bill Number (EWB); attaches vehicle number and transport distance
Notes: Supported via NIC E-Way Bill offline JSON generator and direct GSP API integration.

Task / Business Action: Update transport vehicle number / Transporter ID on active E-Way Bill during breakdown
Business Outcome: Maintain valid E-Way Bill Part B when delivery truck breaks down or transshipment occurs
Downstream Impact: Updates vehicle registration number on active EWB; prints updated transport endorsement
Notes: Supported via E-Way Bill Vehicle Update action (/sales/e-way-bills/{id}/update-vehicle/).

Task / Business Action: Extend E-Way Bill validity before expiry due to transit delay or traffic accident
Business Outcome: Prevent vehicle impoundment and 200% tax penalty by extending validity within 8-hour window
Downstream Impact: Extends EWB validity based on remaining distance; records reason code (Accident/Traffic)
Notes: Supported via E-Way Bill Extension workflow compliant with Rule 138(10) of CGST Rules.

Task / Business Action: Generate live B2B E-Invoice with IRN and Signed QR via NIC/IRP portal
Business Outcome: Mandatory statutory compliance for businesses exceeding legal turnover threshold
Downstream Impact: Uploads invoice payload to IRP; receives 64-char Hash IRN, Ack No, and Signed QR code
Notes: Supported via E-Invoice JSON payload generator and direct IRP integration.

Task / Business Action: Print IRN, Ack No, and cryptographic QR code on customer tax invoice PDF
Business Outcome: Render legal B2B tax invoice PDF containing verifiable cryptographic B2B signed QR code
Downstream Impact: Embeds 500x500 signed QR bitmap and IRN string on top-right of standard invoice layout
Notes: Core rendering invariant: Rule 48(4) compliant PDF invoice template with IRN & Signed QR.

Task / Business Action: Cancel E-Invoice within 24 hours on IRP portal with cancellation reason code
Business Outcome: Legally cancel incorrectly issued e-invoice within statutory 24-hour window
Downstream Impact: Submits cancellation to IRP; voids IRN; updates document status to E_INVOICE_CANCELLED
Notes: Supported via E-Invoice Cancel modal with mandatory reason code (1: Duplicate, 2: Data Error).

Task / Business Action: Year-end financial closing: carry forward ledger balances and initialize new financial year
Business Outcome: Formal financial year-end closing transferring P&L net profit to Reserves and initializing opening TB
Downstream Impact: Closes 31st March financial books; rolls forward asset and liability balances into 1st April opening
Notes: Supported via Year-End Financial Close Wizard (/accounting/year-end-close/).

Task / Business Action: Supplier cancelled GSTIN after issuing invoice: system blocks ITC and alerts purchase team
Business Outcome: Supplier was active when bill was dated but cancelled GSTIN before filing GSTR-1; system flags tax risk
Downstream Impact: Quarantines Input Tax Credit; holds pending payments to supplier until tax filing status is resolved
Notes: GSTIN status verification engine cross-checking active registration status before ITC claim.

Task / Business Action: Companies (Accounts) Rules Rule 3(1) and Rule 11(g) audit trail compliance certification
Business Outcome: Generate cryptographic certification log proving that software edit log feature was enabled at all times
Downstream Impact: Renders MCA Audit Trail Compliance Report detailing database immutability and user change logs
Notes: MCA Rule 11(g) compliance export module verifying zero disabled audit logging intervals.

Task / Business Action: Control user access by shop
Business Outcome: Restrict store staff to accessing only their assigned shop's billing and inventory records
Downstream Impact: Enforces Row-Level Security (RLS) and warehouse assignment guards on API and UI
Notes: Supported via CompanyUser.assigned_warehouses and tenant permission boundaries.

Task / Business Action: Maintain an audit trail
Business Outcome: Immutable change log capturing who edited, approved, or cancelled any financial transaction
Downstream Impact: Stores timestamp, user ID, IP address, previous value, and new value for every record mutation
Notes: Supported via Django SimpleHistory and immutable ActivityLog; satisfies MCA audit trail mandates.

Task / Business Action: Review audit logs
Business Outcome: Inspect comprehensive immutable audit trail of all record creates, updates, and deletions
Downstream Impact: Queries ActivityLog and simple_history tables; provides legal compliance evidence
Notes: Supported via /settings/audit-logs/ with user, entity, and date filtering.

Task / Business Action: Distributed Redis token bucket rate limiting on public-facing API endpoints
Business Outcome: Prevent brute force password guessing, OTP flooding, and DDoS attacks on auth and public checkout APIs
Downstream Impact: Enforces strict per-IP and per-tenant rate limits (e.g. max 5 login attempts/min, 100 API requests/min)
Notes: Django Ratelimit with Redis backend; returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

Task / Business Action: Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) tenant isolation enforcement
Business Outcome: Hardware-enforced tenant isolation guaranteeing Company A can never view or modify Company B data
Downstream Impact: Sets GUC app.company_id per database connection; rejects any query attempting cross-tenant access
Notes: PostgreSQL native Row-Level Security (RLS) policies on all tenant-scoped tables.

Task / Business Action: Field-level role masking for sensitive commercial margins and cost prices
Business Outcome: Billing clerks and delivery staff cannot inspect supplier purchase costs or gross margin percentages
Downstream Impact: Omits cost_price and margin fields from JSON serializer response based on requesting user role
Notes: Role-scoped serializer field permissions in Django REST Framework.

Task / Business Action: Granular export permission gate preventing bulk customer list exfiltration
Business Outcome: Prevent disgruntled departing employees from exporting customer phone numbers and sales registers to Excel
Downstream Impact: Blocks export button and HTTP export endpoints for non-admin roles; logs export access attempts
Notes: Dedicated permission 'can_export_master_data' restricted to Owner and Admin roles.

Task / Business Action: Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) two-factor authentication (2FA) for admin roles
Business Outcome: Enforce Google Authenticator / TOTP 2FA for users accessing financial and tax filing screens
Downstream Impact: Requires 6-digit TOTP code during login; prevents account compromise from stolen passwords
Notes: TOTP 2FA implementation using django-otp library.

Task / Business Action: Instant user deactivation and immediate JWT session revocation
Business Outcome: Terminate an employee's access in 1 click; immediately revokes all active mobile and desktop sessions
Downstream Impact: Blacklists active JWT tokens in Redis; drops WebSocket connections; prevents further API calls
Notes: Redis JWT token revocation blocklist evaluated on every authenticated request.

Task / Business Action: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and SQL injection sanitization on document notes and inputs
Business Outcome: Sanitize all user-entered notes, customer names, and invoice descriptions to prevent malicious script injection
Downstream Impact: Strips HTML/script tags using Bleach library; parameterizes all raw SQL queries
Notes: Core framework invariant: parameterized ORM queries and input HTML sanitization.

Task / Business Action: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) and secure cookie flags enforcement
Business Outcome: Enforce HTTPS across all traffic; set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax flags on all session cookies
Downstream Impact: Prevents man-in-the-middle packet sniffing and session cookie theft over unsecured public Wi-Fi
Notes: Production SSL settings: SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=31536000, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=True.

Task / Business Action: Self-service tenant signup and automated workspace database provisioning
Business Outcome: New merchant signs up on website, verifies phone via OTP, and gets active company workspace in 60s
Downstream Impact: Creates Company, initial CompanyUser (OWNER), default Chart of Accounts, and primary Warehouse
Notes: Automated tenant onboarding pipeline provisioning company defaults and seed accounts.

Task / Business Action: Subscription tier and plan quota enforcement engine (Invoices/month, SKUs, Users)
Business Outcome: Enforce commercial plan limits (Free: 100 bills/mo, Pro: 2,000 bills/mo, Enterprise: Unlimited)
Downstream Impact: Checks monthly invoice count before invoice completion; prompts 1-click plan upgrade if limit reached
Notes: Subscription Plan Quota validator checking tenant usage against active tier limits.

Task / Business Action: Automated tenant data isolation audit and penetration testing verification
Business Outcome: Continuous automated testing proving that no tenant can ever execute SQL query accessing another tenant's row
Downstream Impact: Executes synthetic multi-tenant test suite simulating cross-tenant query injection attacks
Notes: Automated pytest multi-tenant isolation verification test suite running in CI/CD pipeline.

Task / Business Action: Configure fiscal year document numbering series with custom prefix (e.g. INV/26-27/0001)
Business Outcome: Maintain statutory consecutive invoice numbering unique across each financial year per GST Rule 46
Downstream Impact: Creates DocumentSequence record; enforces sequential numbers without gaps across FY
Notes: Supported via /settings/document-series/ with financial year variable tokens ({FY}, {BRANCH}).

Task / Business Action: One-Click Complaint-to-Credit Note / Return / Replacement
Business Outcome: Directly transitions an inspected, approved customer complaint into downstream operational documents in one click: GST Credit Note, Sales Return, or Zero-Value Replacement Order (complaintDocument).
Downstream Impact: Eliminates duplicate manual data entry across support and billing desks; automatically updates inventory ledgers and customer khata balances simultaneously.
Notes: Implements complaintDocument API endpoint supporting 'create-return', 'create-credit-note', and 'create-replacement-order'.

Task / Business Action: One-Click Supplier Complaint-to-Purchase Debit Note Engine
Business Outcome: Converts approved supplier quality rejections directly into official GST Purchase Debit Notes (createSupplierDebitNote) with itemized tax reversals.
Downstream Impact: Instantly debits the vendor's ledger balance; guarantees recovery of funds or credit for defective inward materials before paying upcoming supplier invoices.
Notes: Implements createSupplierDebitNote API from web/src/api/growth.ts with idempotency protection.

Task / Business Action: Approve important business actions
Business Outcome: Authorize sensitive actions: credit limit overrides, manual stock write-offs, discount exceptions
Downstream Impact: Review pending approval queue; approve or reject with recorded digital signature and comments
Notes: Supported via Manager Approval workflow and authorization modal prompts.

Task / Business Action: Manage backups/recovery
Business Outcome: Ensure automated daily database backups and test disaster recovery procedures
Downstream Impact: Executes encrypted PostgreSQL pg_dump; archives to isolated secondary storage
Notes: Supported via automated daily cron / scripts/backup.sh with point-in-time recovery capability.

Task / Business Action: Database connection pooling and keep-alive configuration for sudden traffic spikes
Business Outcome: Prevent 'Too Many Connections' database errors during Diwali/Akshaya Tritiya peak retail rushes
Downstream Impact: Maintains PgBouncer connection pool with transaction-level reuse; handles 1,000+ concurrent clients
Notes: PgBouncer transaction-mode connection pooler configured in front of PostgreSQL.
